meta_description: SRS Locksmiths Newcastle provides emergency lockout, lock repair and installation across Newcastle. Fast response, 24/7 available. Call now for rapid help.
hero_subhead: Locked out at midnight? We're here round the clock to get you back in, fast and without fuss.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to new lock fitting and repair, we handle every lock problem fast and professionally.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, office or car? We'll gain entry safely without damage. Most call-outs completed within 30 minutes in Newcastle city centre.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken, sticking or worn locks fixed or replaced the same day. We source quality locks and fit them properly, so they last.

services.title: New Lock Installation
services.desc: Upgrading your home security? We fit modern, secure locks to doors and windows. Fitted to manufacturers' standards with guarantees included.

services.title: UPVC Door Repairs
services.desc: Broken handles, hinges and locks on uPVC doors repaired without replacing the whole frame. Usually fixed same visit.

services.title: Commercial Lock Services
services.desc: Office and shop lockouts, master key systems and multi-lock fitting. We work round the clock to keep your business secure.

services.title: Lock Changes After Break-In
services.desc: Worried about old keys after a burglary? We'll change your locks and advise on upgrades to improve your home security.

about_pullquote: I started SRS because no one answers the phone at 2am when you're locked out.
about_para_1: SRS Locksmiths was founded on a simple principle: when you're locked out or in a panic, you need someone who answers the phone and gets to you fast. Over eight years, we've built a reputation for genuine 24/7 availability and honest, no-fuss service across Newcastle. We carry a full range of locks and tools on every callout, so most jobs are resolved on the spot.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we don't overcharge for emergencies and we always explain what we're doing. We don't upsell unnecessary work—if a lock can be repaired instead of replaced, we'll tell you. That's why so many Newcastle households and local businesses call us back.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Customers Say About SRS

reviews.text: Locked myself out at half past midnight on a Sunday. Phoned SRS and a locksmith was at my door in 25 minutes. Got me in without any damage to the door. Brilliant service, very reasonable price. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Our office lock broke on a Friday afternoon. SRS fitted a new one within two hours. Professional work, arrived when they said they would, and the new lock is solid. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Emma C.

reviews.text: Had a break-in and needed all my locks changed urgently. The SRS lad came out, was honest about what needed doing, and fitted everything properly. Felt safer straight away. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Michael K.
